description: Find pages on remodelyourvibe.com by keyword. Searches all services, service-by-city pages, service areas and remodeling articles, and returns each match's title, URL, section and a one-sentence summary. Use it first to locate the right page, then read that page with fetch_page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Keywords to look for, for example "pool remodel cost Orange County" or "ADU permit Pasadena".

section.description: Optional. Restrict results to one part of the site.

name: search_site
title: Search the website
